newsitem.title: USA: Texas electricity prices hold steady into Monday.
newsitem.headline: Texas electricity prices hold steady into Monday.

text.p: Bulk wholesale power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held steady Friday for deals booked through the weekend and Monday, brokers and marketers said.
Peak, firm electricity in ERCOT for weekend and Monday delivery was said to be holding at $23.00-24.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), the sources said.
Off-peak ERCOT power for weekend and Monday delivery was lower at $14.00-17.00 from Thursday talk at $15.00-18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh).
November peak ERCOT power was discussed steady at $21.00-21.50, while December held in the $21.50-23.00 range, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
